sections.title: Dates and Age
sections.content: Spanish does age with 'tener', not with 'ser': you have twenty-five years. So it is 'tengo veinticinco años', never 'soy veinticinco'. Dates work to one pattern — 'el' plus the number plus 'de' plus the month, with no capital letter on the month: el doce de mayo.

items.spanish: Mi cumpleaños es el doce de mayo.
items.english: My birthday is on the twelfth of May.

items.spanish: El próximo mes hacemos un viaje juntos.
items.english: Next month we're taking a trip together.

sections.content: English drops 'years old' in speech, Spanish never drops 'años': 'tengo veinticinco años'. And a date needs no 'on' — 'el doce de mayo' already means on the twelfth.
